note: Shared by arm H and arm N. Only the teacher label differs. Fixed before any pilot label was computed.

network.activation: clipped ReLU [0, 1] on the accumulator and the hidden layer

target.mix_normalization: per-sample weighted mean over the available terms, as in v1

weighting.per_game_normalization: 1 / rows from the same source game, as in v1

optimizer.schedule: linear warmup for 2 epochs, then cosine to 0 at the last epoch
optimizer.checkpoint: the model after the last epoch; no checkpoint is chosen by any validation metric

determinism: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), 1 CPU thread, seeded epoch shuffles
quantization: unchanged v1 scales and integer types from build/nnue_phase1_evidence/quantization_contract_v2.json, via the v1 exporter's own functions
